headline: Approved October minutes and will skip the December meeting; Rt 102 sign location and fundraising talks continue.
summary: Talks on moving the Rt 102 sign continue, with a site right off the 93 exit 4 suggested. Fundraising ideas included a scavenger hunt and a brewery night out. Over-55 communities may be approached about interest in the fall cleanup.
decisions: Approved the October meeting minutes, all in favor.
Will skip the December meeting and meet next in January 2027.

plain_text:
Beautify Londonderry Committee 
      Draft Meeting Minutes 11/17/2026 
Sunnycrest Room - Town Hall, 7 PM 
  
 
  
I. Call to order:  7:01 PM Present: Joy Fraga Muller, Beth Murray, John Loker and John 
Mahon.  
  
II. Public comment – none present.  
 
III. Approval of October meeting minutes. B. Murray motion, J. Fraga Muller second, 
all in favor. 
  
IV. Welcome to Londonderry Signs update 
 
- Sponsor Signs Discussion  
o J. Mahon tried to contact one of the old sponsors with no response.  
- Rt 102 Sign Location Change –  
o J. Mahon is continuing the conversation. Working with liaison suggested a 
location that is right off of the 93 exit 4 (coming from N).  J. Mahon will 
move forward writing a letter to the state DOT and stay in touch with the 
Rotary Club.  
o J. Loker will schedule a time to talk with a local realtor who was an 
original sponsor – trying by the end of the year.  
 
V. AI Fundraising Ideas Discussion 
 
- B. Murray is working on the idea of a scavenger hunt.  Discussion that the effort 
would be a lot and may not be worth the potential gain.  
- Still working on the idea of a brewery night out 
- J. Mahon will ask about putting our name co-sponsor with the Green Team into 
for charity money from casinos. 
- General consensus is that we need an alternative activity for the fall cleanup.  It 
has not had the draw in the past few years.    
o Committee will pursue the idea of approaching over-55 communities to see 
if we can get interest – especially those who like to walk. 
o J. Loker 
 
VI. New Member ideas: 
- J. Fraga Muller will ask Green Council for students; recruiting target is for 2 
students.  
- J. Mahon is continuing Facebook posting regularly 
Next Meeting: 
1/19/2026
VII. Election of Officers – 2027. 
- J. Loker motioned to maintain J. Mahon as Chair; J. Fraga Muller as Secretary. 
 
VIII. Public comment – none present 
  
IX. Round table discussion  
- We will skip the December meeting and meet next in January 2027. We will keep 
the 3rd Tuesday of the month at 7 PM, Sunnycrest. 
  
X. Meeting adjournment – 7:56 J. Loker motion for adjourn, B.  Murray second, all in 
favor.  
  
2026 Meeting Dates: 3rd Tuesday of the month at 7pm  
  
1/20/26 5/19/26 9/15/26 
2/16/26 6/16/26 10/20/26 
3/17/26 7/21/26 11/17/26 
4/21/26 8/18/26 12/15/26 
 
 
 
 
Action items: 
- J. Mahon: Continue contact with state for the 5th Londonderry Town Sign.  
- J. Loker: Brainstorm ideas for how we may pursue recruitment of “trash 
ambassadors” and building up a community.  
- B. Murray: Contact local brewery for the idea of a fall night out for fundraising.  
- J. Fraga Muller: Write out the Sponsor a Spot contract in a more user-friendly 
form; contact school for student volunteers (Green Council). Ideas for ELOs: 
Marketing, Public Works, Community Service, Environmental Waste Services. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
*Meeting minutes prepared by Beautify Londonderry Secretary, Jocelyn Fraga Muller.
